# Saverio Morelli

> Frontend Developer & UX Designer

Saverio Morelli is a frontend developer and UX designer based in Italy. He builds open-source software, browser extensions, and Android apps. He graduated in Multimedia Communication and Information Technologies (M.Sc.) at University of Udine with 110/110 cum laude, and holds a B.Sc. in Computer Science from University of Trento. He works at Fondazione Bruno Kessler (FBK) as Frontend App Developer and UX Designer.

## Projects

- [Notefox](https://www.notefox.eu): Take notes on any website. Private, open-source, with sync across devices. Available for Firefox, Chrome, and Edge.
- [Sav PDF Viewer](https://www.savpdfviewer.com): Private, open-source PDF reader for Android. No ads, no permissions, no tracking. Used by 100,000+ people.
- [Emoji](https://www.emojiaddon.com): Browser add-on to copy or insert any emoji with a click. Search by keywords, color, or gender.
- [savmrl.it](https://savmrl.it): Free, anonymous link shortener and redirecting service.
- [Accented Letters](https://github.com/Sav22999/accented-letters-addons): Firefox add-on to copy accented and special characters.
- [Limite](https://github.com/Sav22999/limite): Browser add-on that tracks how much time you spend on each website.
- [Word of the Day](https://github.com/Sav22999/word-of-the-day): Learn a new word every day. An Android app.
- [Chess](https://www.saveriomorelli.com/projects/chess/): Free online chess in the browser. Play a friend with a room code, a random opponent, on the same device or against the computer, with tips, clock and chat. Built with Claude AI.
- [FoodTrack](https://www.saveriomorelli.com/projects/foodtrack/): Web app (installable on Android) to track the food at home in spaces like fridge, freezer and pantry, get alerts on expiring products, share shopping lists and spaces with your household, plan your weekly meals and find recipes with the ingredients you already have. In English and Italian.
- [Giftwise](https://www.saveriomorelli.com/projects/giftwise/): Web app (installable on Android) for wish lists for every occasion. Follow your friends to see their lists, mark a wish as "I'm getting it" and chat with the other followers, without the list owner ever seeing it. In English and Italian.
- [Fucina](https://www.saveriomorelli.com/projects/fucina/): Web app to learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript and PHP by playing: levels of growing difficulty, quick drills, games, a daily challenge with leaderboards and certificates unlocked with the points earned. In English and Italian.
- [FaceGuess](https://www.saveriomorelli.com/projects/faceguess/): Free two-player face-guessing web game with new characters every match. Play a friend online or in person. Built with Claude AI.
- [Sudoku](https://www.saveriomorelli.com/projects/sudoku/): Free Sudoku in the browser with four levels, pencil notes and pen, tips that explain the next move, cell check, timer and saved games. Built with Claude AI.
- [Connect Four](https://www.saveriomorelli.com/projects/connect-four/): Free online four-in-a-row game (Forza Quattro). Play a friend with a room code, a random opponent, on the same device or against the computer, with custom disc colors and chat. Built with Claude AI.
- [LetterHop](https://www.saveriomorelli.com/projects/letterhop/): Free word ladder game in the browser: go from one word to another changing one letter at a time. Three levels, words of 5 or 6 letters, dictionaries in five languages, and the fewer words you use, the more points you get. Built with Claude AI.
- [ThinkHop](https://www.saveriomorelli.com/projects/thinkhop/): Free logic game in the browser: liars, treasure chests, mini sudoku, absurd reasoning and traps across 500 levels, with a daily ranking and friends. Five languages, works offline. Built with Claude AI.
- [HTML per tutti](https://www.saveriomorelli.com/htmlpertutti/): A book to learn HTML from scratch, written in Italian. Available on Amazon.
